beats.text: Exercise eight. You build an organizer dashboard in eleven tasks. Each task uses one idea from Day one.
beats.caption: Exercise 8. You build an organizer dashboard in eleven tasks. Each task uses one idea from Day 1.

beats.text: Run npm run reset first. Only page and route files get a U R L.
beats.caption: Run npm run reset first. Only page and route files get a URL.

beats.text: Tasks one and two. A layout wraps every page and stays mounted. A client link marks the current page.
beats.caption: Tasks 1 and 2. A layout wraps every page and stays mounted. A client link marks the current page.

beats.text: Tasks three to five. Server Components await their data. Promise dot all reads both together. The client table gets plain data and holds the filter.
beats.caption: Tasks 3 to 5. Server Components await their data. Promise.all reads both together. The client table gets plain data and holds the filter.

beats.text: Task six. The vote is a Server Action. The browser gets only an I D, and update Tag refreshes the cache.
beats.caption: Task 6. The vote is a Server Action. The browser gets only an ID, and updateTag refreshes the cache.

beats.text: Tasks seven and eight. Loading shows a placeholder at once. Error catches a crash. Not found handles a missing talk. The sidebar stays.
beats.caption: Tasks 7 and 8. loading shows a placeholder at once. error catches a crash. not-found handles a missing talk. The sidebar stays.

beats.text: Tasks nine and ten. Metadata names each tab, and a Route Handler sends JSON.
beats.caption: Tasks 9 and 10. Metadata names each tab, and a Route Handler sends JSON.

beats.text: Task eleven. A client provider holds the theme. Server pages pass through as children. Local storage keeps the choice, and an effect loads it.
beats.caption: Task 11. A client provider holds the theme. Server pages pass through as children. localStorage keeps the choice, and a useEffect loads it.

beats.text: Short on time? Skip tasks four, six, nine, ten and eleven. Then compare with the solution.
